description: Reach to bolt bin, get one bolt from mixed bin
Move bolt to bag held open by left hand, release
Reach to washer bin, get one washer (small, flat)
Move washer to bag, release
Reach to nut bin, get one nut
Move nut to bag, release
Grasp bag top with both hands, press seal closed
Move bag to tote, release
Reach for next empty bag, get from stack (selective: thin film)
Move bag to opening position, open bag (fingers)
Reach both hands to gravity trays (bolt RH, nut LH, pre-oriented), get both at once
Move both to bag on holder, release (low control: simultaneous)
Reach to washer tray (pre-singulated), get washer
Move washer to bag, release
Press seal: both hands
Slide bag off holder into chute
Pull next bag from roll on holder (perforated, self-opening)
Reach to tote, get housing
Move housing to fixture, place on two locating pins
Reach to pin tray, get one dowel pin
Move pin to bore, insert (tight fit, one correction)
Seat pin with thumb
Reach to hanging power driver, get
Move driver to screw 1, engage (bit to recess)
Drive screw 1 (tool time)
Move driver to screw 2, engage
Drive screw 2 (tool time)
Release driver to balancer
Look at assembly, decide: pin flush and screws seated?
Get assembly from fixture
Move to outgoing conveyor, place
Walk to carton pallet (3 steps)
Bend to pallet (floor level) and arise with carton
Get carton with both hands (8 kg)
Walk back to bench (3 steps), carrying
Move carton to bench, place against stop (loaded move: 4 kg per hand)
Read label: part number and quantity (4 groups)
Decide: label matches order?
Reach to tape gun, get
Move tape gun to carton seam, place
Pull tape across lid (whole arm)
Aside tape gun
Slide carton to outgoing roller
Turn to carton lift table at bench height (no walking), get carton (8 kg)
Move carton to bench, place against stop (loaded)
Scan label with fixed scanner (look, decide on beep/light)
Reach to tape gun on holder at seam start, get
Pull tape across lid
Return tape gun to holder
Push carton to outgoing roller
Reach to cable pile on bench, get one cable end (tangled)
Move cable end to coiling jig, hook on peg
Turn coiling crank 4 revolutions
Reach to twist-tie dispenser, get one tie
Move tie around coil, align both ends
Twist tie ends with fingers (3 twists)
Get coil off jig
Move coil to bag on holder, drop in
Read cable label (2 groups) and decide: right length code?
